summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I did:** read-only audit of the full path — no edits made, per instructions for this high-impact ticket.  ### Audit findings (the surprise)  I traced the whole chain end to end and, on paper, it looks correct:  - `WatchlistPage.tsx` fetches via the shared `api` client, which sets `credentials: "include"` on every request — no localStorage/anonymous fallback, no cached "guest" watchlist id. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own embedded auth middleware (`watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)`) that validates the `arca_session`
